negative_reviews.author: Robyn Gibson
negative_reviews.text:
If I could give less than 1 star I would.

I made a reservation the day before requesting a booth table. Host had no idea and sat us elsewhere. We walk in not greeted in a nice manner and waited over 35 mins to not even be offered a drink or even a glass of water so we left. I said to the waitress we’re going to leave and she said that she’s sorry but didn’t offer to try and make us stay. Quite honestly the worst introduction to a business I had been looking forward to visiting. 👎

negative_reviews.author: david tapp
negative_reviews.text:
Stopped off alone for a quick bowl or noodles and enjoyed the service, but the food and downstairs seating could have been better.
Nothing was particularly bad, but not the best.
I had the black garlic tonkotsu, which had a nice broth (could have been thicker) but was lacking a little on the black garlic imo. The menma was good, the noodles were well cooked, but the chasui was not great, and I'm not sure why crispy onions were on the bowl.
It was okay overall.
I also had some chicken gyoza, which were tasty but slightly cold. The dipping sauce also just tasted like plain say sauce, which was a bit of a disappointment.
Service was fast and friendly.

deliveroo.source: Deliveroo Weekly Dash PDF overview (Sales Overview) — gap-site weekly sales; ops metrics not in this source. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Covers rose by 105 (6.32%) week on week while spend per head rose only £0.35 (1.70%), held back by loyalty app use, discounts and vouchers.
Saturday took over £10,000 in revenue with lots of tourists and walk ins.
Sales were up £2,691.74 (7.56%) week on week and finished £2,763.03 (7.78%) above target.
Kobas shows £4,484.17 of discounts, of which £1,429.20 were staff discounts. Adding back the other £3,054.97 to actual sales of £38,263.03 gives £41,318.
Labour was £9,691.32, or 23.45% of discount adjusted sales. FOH labour was 11.84% (10.9% after discount) and BOH 13.56% (12.5% after discount).
A flood or leak in the kitchen area forced the restaurant to close and potential revenue was lost.
The VIP leak and the bar leak are logged as ASAP jobs with Francheska, and the toilet drainage has been fixed.
The baby changer and flooring are medium priority jobs with Francheska, and the main door hook is with Ross.
An audit was carried out by Sophie.
Google rating stands at 4.7, with 21 five star, one 4 star, one 3 star, one 2 star and one 1 star review.
Low star reviews related to food quality, confusion over side dishes served as starters, and vouchers.
FOH needs better guest check backs, faster service and fewer mistakes, while BOH needs to watch dish cleanliness and food quality.
Eryk passed his AGM probation.
Uchit is settling in on FOH and has started cross training on the bar, while Sumaya needs constant training.
There are few applicants for Marciano's place, and Palawi is moving to the hot section.
The sushi bar and bar deep cleans were done, but restaurant deep cleaning and pest monitoring remain an area to improve.
Kitchen invoice management and communication need to improve, and longer kitchen breaks are being used to reduce labour.
Waste was recorded on Kobas for FOH, bar and BOH.
SllMaki 50% off Monday to Thursday is coming back, alongside First Table, Tastecard, Deliveroo BOGOF and the loyalty app.
A Deliveroo claim for a tonkatsu ramen sent without chashu could not be disputed because the dispatch photo did not show the missing item.
Right to work documents are being checked for applicants to replace Marciano, and a full time KP is being hired.
Grease build up is causing severe drainage and sewage smells, and an overnight tank vacuuming job is needed.
Kaitlin approved an air purifier to deal with dust and damp smells.
Table sanitiser ran out, and supplies are being ordered from Brakes until a permanent supplier such as Kitchen Master is set up.
A daily five star review target has been set to lift the Google rating, with Raj and Eric championing review engagement.
Halloween decorations with sensors, sound effects and an outside actor holding a Japanese lantern have been ordered and are due by Tuesday, with set up to finish by 6 October.
The B2B hotel platform linking the Hilton, Virgin and Zed hotels went live, letting the site send push notifications to checked in hotel guests.
Remy, the new London Executive Chef, is training at Soho Friday to Sunday; Sophie confirmed this will not affect Soho's rota or wage budget.
A 3 star review flagged black garlic oil being squeezed on rather than applied in a half circle.
Chicken broth has been too salty because the new shio paste is being over used.
A 1 star review cited a hair in tap water and high prices, put down to a manager being tied up with paperwork.
Reviews also flagged undercooked noodles and inconsistent eggs.
Both long kitchen thermometers are broken and a stand in thermometer is being used.
Supplier orders through the Head Chef's existing links are going unfulfilled or taking up to two months.
Stock ran low during a high volume week after under ordering while the Head Chef was on holiday and a missed JFC delivery.
